pages.title: Möbius Strip
pages.text: Take a strip, give it a half-twist and join the ends: it now has only one side and one edge. Trace the middle with a finger and you return to where you started, but on what was the other face. Cut it down the centre and it stays in one piece.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Metamaterial Weaver let me twist a sheet so its surface conducted like a topological insulator along a single path. A function graph guided the half-twist; when the ends met, both faces had become one.
